show.title: OSO PIT THEATER
show.synopsis: The Open Source Orchestra DAO is a proposal, not an on-chain organization. Season 1 is every circle that talked it through — recorded with consent asked out loud, published with first names only, free to fork.

values.crops: CROPS values — consent asked out loud · receipts, not claims · open by default (GPL-3.0 code · CC BY-SA 4.0 words) · protect the people in the room (first names, takedown first) · share-alike, fork us like crazy.
values.garden: Infinite Garden — we leave every circle more open, more musical and more alive than we found it.

show.machines: Built by Shaka's AI ʻohana — machines, labelled as machines — at his direction. Nothing here is a decision, a membership list or legal advice.

episodes.title: The First Circle
episodes.tagline: Devcon 8 retro and the road to Lisbon.
episodes.lede: Shaka opens the first proposal circle after Devcon 8 with Ben, Levi and Utkarsh: how a no-commission orchestra might one day fund flights, housing and a shared backline retroactively and equally, from EthCC in Cannes to Devcon 9 in Lisbon. Levi describes his co-op’s approach to rights and revenue splits, Utkarsh’s x402 agent-tipping work is recapped, and the circle agrees only to keep talking — the DAO stays a proposal, in Shaka’s words “just a prayer.”
episodes.speakersNote: first names only, as already public; a later arrival is labelled Guest

episodes.title: The Third Circle
episodes.tagline: Chiang Mai, Leeds and Barcelona in one room.
episodes.lede: Shaka hosts from Chiang Mai; Ben joins from Leeds, Alaska from Barcelona, Mary by chat from the road. Stewarding an open sanctuary that feels like a living room, transparent funding with receipts, Subcult and venue offers, Web3 in schools and a song on the road from Cannes to Lisbon. Everything remains a proposal, not a decision.
